source_text: δὴ οὖν ἔσται τὸ οὖς τοῖς τῆς ἀκριβείας καὶ δογματικῆς ὀρθότητος ἐπιμεληταῖς. Ἀλλὰ τοῦτό ἐστι Χριστοῦ τὸ δῶρον καὶ ξένιον οὐρανοῦ, καὶ κατόρθωσις αἵματος τοῦ ἁγίου· ἁπάντων γὰρ ἡμῖν τῶν ἐξαιρέτων ἡ κτῆσις ἐν αὐτῷ τε καὶ δι' αὐτοῦ. Τοιγάρτοι
pass_a_gloss: …ous cheir pous… sōma tou Christou… allogenēs…
pass_b_english: Cyril: …will be the ear for those caring for exactness and dogmatic uprightness. But this is Christ’s gift and heaven’s guest-gift, and an achievement of the holy blood; for of all the exceptional things for us the possession is in him and through him. Therefore also a hand was being sanctified, showing-forth of practical energy, and indeed also a foot, a clear symbol of the uprightness in tracks. For we must be solemnized with holy deeds, and walk through very well the path running through unto every one of the things pleasing God, according to what is sung in Psalms, ‘And I turned my feet unto your testimonies,’ (Psalm 119:59) or the in Proverbs book, ‘Make upright tracks for your feet, and straighten your roads.’ (Proverbs 4:26) So then let the sacred and choice race possess a holy hearing, and likewise hand and foot according at least to the manners just said for us; and all right things being anointed and as in a last portion—that is, in extremes. For he says the extreme of the ear, and indeed also… For how would it be fitting for the sacred ones to come to be in participation of holy food—that is, of the body of Christ—and unapproachable for the other-born is the blessing. And other-born would also be thought the still unbelieving and unbaptized race, and in addition to these still the having been twisted unto other-minded mind, and incompatible with the judgments of the saints, and as in baseness of dogmas having been rope-separated. And with fire is also spent every leftover of the sacrifice (1 Corinthians 10:16) (Exodus 29:20–34)
